description:
Experience elevated city living in this beautifully designed Nob Hill residence, where classic architecture meets modern convenience. This pet-friendly, smoke-free property offers secure gated entry, intercom access, and security cameras, ensuring a safe and private environment. Residents enjoy a beautiful garden courtyard, shared backyard, and BBQ area, perfect for relaxation or social gatherings. Additional conveniences include a common area laundry facility, motorcycle parking, and an organized waste disposal system for trash, recycling, and compost. With an online payment portal, professional maintenance support, and dedicated resident services, everyday living is seamless. Located just moments from Grace Cathedral, the Cable Car Museum, and the bustling Polk Apartments dining and shopping scene, this home provides access to the best of San Francisco with public transportation and major streets nearby for easy commuting.
If you’re interested in the property, please send us your phone number. We’ll get in touch with you as soon as possible to provide more details and answer any questions you may have.
